standard-dialogue.text: If the player has not spoken to him before:
If the player has spoken to him before:

steps.npc: I'm a Knight of Varlamore, the Kingdom of Sun. I venture to Kourend on a mission, one I can say very little of.
I'm afraid you must accept my secrecy adventurer, for who knows what the future holds.

options.text: I found an ancient sun temple.
options.condition: If the player completed In Search of Knowledge:

steps.player: I found an ancient sun temple.

steps.npc: Oh, pray tell, where is this temple?

steps.player: In a place called the Forthos Ruin to the south east of here. I was exploring there and I discovered symbology for an entity called Ralos.

steps.npc: I see. I think I shall check out this ruin. Thank you for letting me know adventurer.

steps.player: No problem... Oh, I don't know your name.

steps.npc: Call me Astra! Now, I must see this discovery for myself. It may well help with my mission here. May the light shine upon you!

steps.text: Astra leaves the castle, and moves to the Altar of the Sun.

options.condition: If the player has never been to Varlamore:

steps.npc: To the south, beyond Mount Quidamortem. It's a glorious land where the sun forever shines.
Not great... Can you believe what they've done?
Are you blind? Look what they've done to the altar of Ralos!

steps.player: Oh... I guess it has seen better days.

steps.npc: It was those others! Those undead druids. Blind moon worshippers...
Do you see what they've become? That's what turning your back on the light does. Even as I stand here in this desecrated temple, I feel the light fading from me.

steps.player: I suppose it is quite spooky down here.

steps.npc: So you feel it too? A shadow hangs over this place.
My mission is still a secret, adventurer. Perhaps I'll share it with you one day.
